_note: THE CONTROL for probe_sheer_bulwark.json, and the whole reason it exists is that "it looks better" is not a measurement anyone can check. This is the same hull, the same bulwark, the same section, the same colours and the same emitter with follow_sheer FALSE: the cap is held at a constant deck_y + height instead of following the hull's own sheer curve. Squint at the two captures side by side. This one is two parallel horizontal bars — the shape the owner described, and the shape every vessel in screenshots/studio has today. The only difference in the input is one boolean.

hull._note: hull_28x10, as FishingTrawlerSmall.make_physics_profile() builds it: 14 x 5 x 2.8 m at WORLD_FEEL_SCALE 2, i.e. a 28 x 10 m vessel with 5.6 m depth and 2.8 m draft. Freeboard 2.8 m x fine_entry bow_keel_rise 0.32 = 0.896 m of sheer forward, 2.8 x 0.10 = 0.28 m aft. Derived, not written down.
